acquisition_channels.details: Upload faceless videos to YouTube; TikTok and Instagram pages are named as alternatives. The transcript does not explain a specific audience-growth tactic.

ideas.delivery: Use Claude and Higsfield to plan, write scripts, make thumbnails and generate scenes; add voice with Higsfield Speak or 11 Labs, edit clips and music in Cap Cut, then upload to YouTube. The owner chooses the niche, reviews and revises outputs, and manages the channel.
ideas.other_uk_rules: If selling paid newsletter subscriptions, UK DMCC Act subscription rules may apply; affiliate promotions may need clear ad disclosure. Research and documentary content can raise copyright, UK GDPR/privacy and defamation issues.
